title: ID0380046-DC/Si-D/AR[DzTyqp] - OCPP message
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
missing a message within the OCPP (Energy.Active.Import.Register)
Root cause:
Solution:
Backend needs to send a command from OCPP:
"MeterValuesSampledData": {
"readonly": false,
"value": "SoC,Power.Offered,Current.Offered,
Energy.Active.Import.Register
"
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active

additional_info.subject: ID0380046-DC/Si-D/AR[DzTyqp] - OCPP message (Energy.Active.Import.Register) CRM:00315001792
additional_info.body:
Hi Sofia, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
Just for clarification, since I didn't fully understand, you are taking over Mariano's role.
Whenever you open a ticket, please always include the Serial Number of the charger since I assume you don't have access to the charger's Siemens backend since you don't have the training.
I would recommend doing the basic training at least so that you can have access to the backend. If you have any questions you can ask to the Trainer's Head:
guilherme.nascimento-ferreira@siemens.com
For the ticket, whenever you open a ticket you will receive an email just like the first one, but since you didn't provide the charger's information I left it with a “?”.
Every detail that I sent except for the Troubleshooting is automatically filled with the charger's information that you provide. So you never have to write in anything.
The troubleshooting is my recommendation of steps to take next from your side. So in this case, you need to ask the backend colleague to send a “GetConfiguration” command with the change of the parameter that they requested. It must look like this
:
"MeterValuesSampledData": {
"readonly": false,
"value": "SoC,Power.Offered,Current.Offered,
Energy.Active.Import.Register
"
If I change this value by myself, after a restart of the charger, this value will disappear as we are not supposed to change this value from our side. The backend will always upload their version of the configuration.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
